title: Pifdenne
summary: Pivdenne is a toponym in Ukraine signifying 'southern' and is associated with various locations and facilities within the country.

sections.heading: Cities Named Pivdenne
paragraphs: [[coal-in-ukraine|In Ukraine]], the name Pivdenne is attributed to two cities: Pivdenne in [[kharkiv-oblast|Kharkiv Oblast]] and Pivdenne in [[odesa-oblast|Odesa Oblast]]. These urban centers contribute to the regional identity and development of their respective oblasts.

sections.heading: Rural Settlements
paragraphs: The name Pivdenne is also used for several rural settlements in Ukraine, specifically located in [[dnipropetrovsk-oblast|Dnipropetrovsk Oblast]] and [[donetsk-oblast|Donetsk Oblast]]. These settlements reflect the agricultural and community aspects of the regions.

sections.heading: Facilities and Structures
paragraphs: KB Pivdenne is a notable facility associated with the name, serving as a designer of rockets and satellites. This institution plays a significant role in Ukraine's aerospace industry and technological advancement.
